svg.aria-label: K-means: assign first, then update Panel: 1. Assign to initial centers Panel: 2. Update each cluster mean Shared axes: x, y 1. Assign to initial centers Feature x: -1 to 9 Feature y: -1 to 3 Cluster A (scatter): a1 A1 (1, 1); a2 A2 (2, 2); a3 A3 (3, 1) Cluster B (scatter): b1 B1 (6, 1); b2 B2 (7, 2); b3 B3 (8, 1) $c_A$: (0, 0) $c_B$: (8, 0) Use nearest-center distance to assign points. The centers stay fixed at $c_A=(0,0)$ and $c_B=(8,0)$. 2. Update each cluster mean Feature x: -1 to 9 Feature y: -1 to 3 Cluster A (scatter): a1 A1 (1, 1); a2 A2 (2, 2); a3 A3 (3, 1) Cluster B (scatter): b1 B1 (6, 1); b2 B2 (7, 2); b3 B3 (8, 1) $c_A$: (2, 1.3333333333333333) $c_B$: (7, 1.3333333333333333) Only centers move: $c_A=(2,\frac{4}{3})$, $c_B=(7,\frac{4}{3})$. Each is the mean of its three points; all samples stay fixed. Illustrative Euclidean K-means with two clusters. Filled marks are samples; hollow marks are centers. Repeat assignment after this update.
